model_name: Probabilistic Adaptive Multi-Graph DCRNN Encoder with Contextual Node Embedding
prediction_definition: [Y_{t-6}, ..., Y_t] -> Y_{t+7}; residual mu = Y_t + predicted_delta
rolling_seven_day_rate_definition: Daily-reported rolling seven-day COVID-19 infection rate per 100,000, not daily new cases.

graph_definitions.mobility: pre-averaged 2019-2023 OD matrix, directed, not real-time flow
graph_definitions.fusion: One global softmax alpha mixes directed diffusion supports. Label: learned relative graph-fusion weights, not COVID risk shares.

context_variable_definitions.pt_gp_min: public transport time to GP, minutes

uncertainty_interpretation.sigma: Predicted standard deviation of the residual-reconstructed rate. Maps should colour by sigma.
uncertainty_interpretation.intervals: Calibrated 80/95 are empirical intervals from frozen calibration scores; not an exchangeability coverage guarantee.
uncertainty_interpretation.uncertainty_flag: Optional binary overlay: sigma > calibration P90. Not required if the map uses continuous sigma.
uncertainty_interpretation.exchangeability_limitation: Rolling seven-day COVID-19 outcomes are temporally overlapping and spatially dependent, so calibrated intervals are empirical uncertainty intervals rather than intervals with a formal exchangeability-based coverage guarantee.

geoshapley_available_for.note: Only GeoShapley computed with the same rolling checkpoint as the displayed forecast.

checkpoint_information.retrospective_geoshapley: Not computed per rolling update. Do not attach the fixed-split GeoShapley file to rolling maps.

split_design: Chronological 65/10/25 by target_date on 1054 frozen S1 windows. Validation internally 50/50 selection then calibration.

warning_definitions.unverified_extrapolation: No observed target on 2023-03-04; exclude from metrics.
warning_definitions.alpha_mean: Descriptive only; do not substitute for a date-specific checkpoint.

website_date_selector: Use website/date_selector.csv only (test issue dates). Do not add train or validation dates.
